map_shape_id: # map_shape_id: The ID of the boundary (riding/district) from map_shapes table
# political_party: Party name (must match existing party in political_parties table)
# source_url: Link to official government page (optional)
# photo_url: URL to official photo - will be downloaded and stored in Supabase (optional)

political_party: country FROM map_shapes WHERE name ILIKE 'riding_name' AND boundary_type LIKE '%Federal%' AND country = 'Canada';
